lucid-flyway.description: Replaced the single account creation step with a more accurate provisioning sequence. The workflow now separates tenant record creation, identity setup, default project creation, and feature flag application before customer messaging.
lucid-flyway.topology-changes: C^tenant[Create tenant record] C^identity[Configure identity provider] C^project[Create default project] C^flags[Apply plan feature flags] C^tenant --> identity C^identity --> project C^project --> flags U^risk -->|Approved| account^risk -->|Approved| tenant U^compliance -->|Cleared| account^compliance -->|Cleared| tenant U^account --> email^flags --> email D^account[Create customer account]
